content: Nyakasane Mwâmi wîrhu ayish’itwîra igulu olubanja

content.text: Nyakasane ayîmire: igulu lishagaluke birhwa binji bicîshinge.
Omwizimya n’ebitù byacîbulwîre, byamugorha, obushinganyanya n’okurhalyalyanya, co ciriba entebe yâge edêkerîrekwo.
Ntakanjirwa omushokolîre; n’ababisha bamugosire ntakanjirwa arhabagezekwo lîno.
Emilazô yâge yo yamoleka igulu, idaho lyabwîne lyanajuguma.
Entondo zôhe kwo zidwîrhe zajongera omu masù ga Nyakasane nka muhomo, omu masù g’orhegeka igulu lyoshi.
Amalunga gadwîrhe gaganîra obushinganyanya bwâge, n’amashanja goshi gabwîne irenge lyâge.
Abagashâniza emirhi mibinje enshonyi zababumbire, na balya bacîkubagira enshanga kwo na kwo; banyamuzinda omu masù gâge bafukamire.
Yâgirwa, Siyoni ayumvîrhe anarhwamwo omunyu, n’ebishagala bya Yûda byoshi bishagalusire, erhi kutwa emmanja kwâwe kwinjà kurhuma.
Bulya oli enyanya ly’igulu lyoshi Yâgirwa, n’omu banyamuzinda boshi ntâye okuhisirekwo oku bulî.
Nyakasane azigira abashomba okubî, arhanahimwa kushîbirira obuzîne bw’abacêse bâge, yêne onabarhenza omu nfune z’abalenzi.
Obumoleke buyishîre omushinganyanya, n’ab’omurhima gushingânîne bàyishîrwe n’omwîshingo.
Sâmi muli Nyakasane mwe bashinganyanya, mukuze n’izîno lyâge litagatîfu.
